permission_status: Authorized offline listeners and Google calls executed through normal approval review. No unresolved permission blocker or weakened protection.

eight_second_stop.conclusion: Almost all old elapsed time preceded tool-handler entry. The old probe stamped time before synchronous evidence saving and send; it did not record send-return or every incoming packet. Exact inference/network/local pre-send attribution cannot be reconstructed. Browser was not in that run.
eight_second_stop.new_instrumentation: Send start/return, every packet kind, tool entry/return, tool-response send, event-loop heartbeat; writes outside timed intervals. No thought/audio/key payload logging.
eight_second_stop.limit: The8.776s outlier was not reproduced in these24 samples. This is not elimination of service tails, a speech deadline or a physical stopping guarantee. Direct Stop/R3 remain independent.

deterministic_fixes: Reproduced delayed HTTP movement arriving after Stop and issuing nonzero fake commands. Strict per-runtime/per-Stop command epochs now reject stale/missing intents before dispatch, including delayed bodies and action-lock waits.

Migrated manual/voice browser bridges, Python HTTP client and legacy shutdown requests. Shared Stop state survives bridge replacement; failed/unknown Stop and stale model intents cannot silently reauthorize movement. Stop/status remain independently available.

Diagnostic CLI now processes later model Stop packets while an earlier HTTP tool response is pending; ordinary action ordering, same-turn cancellation, late-result supersession and bounded cleanup are tested. It still reads typed input one turn at a time and is not an emergency keyboard control.

Stop receipts separately report named running-job cancellation requested/confirmed/pending and removed pending-job counts. No added Stop waits or motion changes. Secret action names are redacted after Stop relocks.
Corrected false separate-stand prerequisite after clean Stop, lie-down posture guarantee and secret unlock/lock Nothing-moved claims. Disabled following is omitted from advertised tools.
Fixed out-of-order browser video conversion and server-camera responses so old frames cannot replace newer sent frames; late conversions cannot send after disconnect.

Camera HTTP now uses an atomic ROS-receipt timestamp, rejects frames older than2s before/after processing, and disables caching. Repeated reads do not refresh age. Browser logs availability transitions once; prior model context is not erased.

prompt_and_model_decisions.medium_rejected: 24 completed cases had2 execution-failing and5 narration-failing cases; matched Stop sample showed no observed benefit over HIGH. No automatic model migration.
prompt_and_model_decisions.later_stop_contract_check: Four cases/12 turns: correct requested actions and no extra standalone stand, but one premature acceptance statement and one misleading running-versus-pending cancellation explanation. Optional run:false was a structural-check false positive, not an action error.
prompt_and_model_decisions.final_bounded_ordering_comparison: After corrected cancellation receipts, control and one-bullet before-speaking candidate each completed9 cases/18 turns with correct actions. Control retained one premature acceptance claim; candidate replaced that with an invented wait-controller claim. Candidate rejected under predefined no-narration-regression criterion; current prompt retained.
prompt_and_model_decisions.remaining: Prompt changes mitigate but do not guarantee truthful speech. Preserve model narration separately from tool receipts and physical observations. Further unstructured prompt churn is not evidence of reliability.

live_and_browser_evidence.refusals_and_secrets: Actual Google6 cases/11 turns: correct caps/unavailable skills/follow refusals, valid recovery move, wrong/right unlock and relock; no password echoes or gate-only movement. Locked-skill explanation omitted password-lock reason in one reply.
live_and_browser_evidence.synthetic_speech: Two manual-activity interruptions passed. Initial automatic finite-audio fixture failed2/2 because it stopped sending without stream-end; retained. Corrected continuous-silence and explicit audio_stream_end each passed2/2, cancelling an active fake wait while model audio was ongoing. No real microphone or physical stop evidence.
live_and_browser_evidence.synthetic_vision: Three actual Google JPEG cases passed independent image/transcript review: two shapes, triangle, and refusal to infer robot posture from unrelated shapes. Fresh session per unique image; does not prove ongoing-stream image replacement or JS-camera-to-Google integration.
